title: Summit 2025: Put on the Whole Armor of God
The Struggle Is Real- Lo-Ammi Richardson
description: A compelling series about God’s transofrmative power to break the cycle of sin in our lives. With heartfelt insight, Lo-Ammi explains why we struggle and reveals the key to finding the lasting peace we all long for. Through seven transformative steps, you’ll learn how to live as a victorious Christian. The struggle is real but so is the victory through Jesus Christ!

title: Anchor 2018: The End-Time Dimensions of the Parables
description: Anchor is a seminary-level course study on the fundamentals of Seventh-day Adventist theology, taught by Pastor Stephen Bohr. The mission of ANCHOR is to settle students into the Truth both intellectually and spiritually and to provide the theological skills to share their new found hope and knowledge with others.

title: His Way Is in the Sanctuary
description: One writer once stated: “The correct understanding of the ministration in the heavenly sanctuary is the foundation of our faith. ” (EV 221).  But why is this so?  What makes the doctrine of the sanctuary so important?In this series, Pastor Bohr explains how the many doctrines of the Bible, such as the divine/human nature of Christ, the salvation of sinful man, the Sabbath, the ten commandments, the state of the dead, the judgment, tithing, healthful living, the work of angels, and even end-time events, are explained in the sanctuary service. With simplicity and clarity he shows how the sanctuary is the great magnet which draws together all the doctrines of the Bible into a unified system of truth. Definitely a must-see!

title: The Book of Acts
description: In the days of the early church—before modern technology or powerful institutions—the Gospel was proclaimed with boldness and urgency across the world. What lessons can today’s remnant church draw from their example? In this compelling series, Kameron Devasher uncovers essential truths from the Apostolic church that will both inspire and challenge remnant believers to share the Three Angels’ Messages with conviction and determination, using every means available.

title: Summit 2022: Behold I Send You Elijah
description: This summit will discuss the different purposes in God appointing us, an imperfect people, to spread the gospel around the world.

title: The Overcomers
description: In this series you will hear some amazing testimonies of individuals whose lives have been transformed by the Lord.

title: Take Charge of Your Health
description: Take Charge of Your Health is a wellness-focused series featuring interviews with medical experts, Bible study of wellness principles, and practical instruction in lifestyle change for health improvement.

title: Heart Wise Ministries - The Heart of Health
description: The Heart of Health is a call in health program providing viewers with an opportunity to call in and get free medical advice from guests who practice medicine every day.

title: It Is Written Canada
description: Mike and René Lemon are the hosts for It Is Written Canada, a nationwide television ministry that spotlights the life-transforming power of trusting God’s Word.

title: Remodeling Your Life - Talking Donkey Int.
description: Discover what has been misunderstood by many for centuries… it’s not about us, rather, It’s all about God. God is the solution — the only One who can lift us up, change our lives and give us victory. Shot in multiple states and more than 90 locations, this series unpacks the key to what the book of Revelation calls, overcoming.

title: Watch and Pray at Midnight
description: Are we living in the "Midnight Hour" referenced in the parable of Matthew 24 and 25? Looking at events taking place around us we can see the approaching crisis. This series will cover different crises affecting the world and what it can teach us about God and our need for a refinement.

title: SUMtv Stories
description: SUMtv sits down with church members and ministry leaders as they share their testimonies of hope, redemption, and spiritual growth.

title: Three Angels Made Practical
description: We may have the theological understanding of the Three Angels Messages but do we understand how to make these messages practical and relevant to our lives? In this ten-part series Lo-ammi Richardson will go text-by-text to help break down the commands to fear God, give glory, and worship Him.

title: Last Generation Theology
description: What is Last Generation Theology? Very likely you've heard this phrase in the church during the past few years. Is it an anti-gospel, legalistic heresy, as some have alleged? Or is it the Bible-based rationale for the existence, message, and mission of the Seventh-day Adventist movement? The purpose of this symposium is to take these questions to the Bible and the writings of the Spirit of Prophecy to discover God's answers.

title: The Best of I'd Like to Know
description: The Best of I'd Like to Know revisits some of the series’ most compelling questions about the Bible, faith, and Christian life. Through Scripture-based answers and thoughtful discussion, these selected episodes invite you to discover timeless biblical truths, and deepen your understanding of God’s Word.

title: It Is Written - with John Bradshaw
description: It Is Written is the flagship program of the It Is Written ministry, which for more than six decades has shared the transforming teachings of the Bible directly from the pages of God’s Word. Presented by Pastor John Bradshaw and often filmed in fascinating and visually stunning locations around the world, It Is Written covers a wide range of Biblical subjects and shares faith in Jesus Christ as the hope of the world.

title: Adverum Productions - Journeys
description: Born in Sweden to Chilean parents, Cacyne learned early to work hard and stand on her own two feet. Struggling with bitterness and resentment stemming from her early experiences, she came to find romantic love and faith in God, but peace eluded her. After choosing to stop compromising, difficulties arose that threatened her career. With her faith revived, a series of doors started to open to a secure future under the providence of her heavenly Father.

title: God's Principles for Healthy Relationships - Season 2
description: Whether you're navigating the complexities of creating relationships or seeking to deepen or mend your current relationships, this series provides invaluable wisdom for a true love and healing that lasts. Drawing from biblical principles and practical strategies, certified Life and Relationship coaches Martin and Debbie Raj share their journey, promoting forgiveness, values, self-worth and joy in Jesus. They address the prevalence of broken families and relationships marred by abusive behaviors, identity crises, lack of leadership, commitment and genuine love. They firmly believe that Happily Ever After is not a myth, but a reality attainable through following God's plan and committing to the necessary effort, with the belief that “In His presence, there is fullness of Joy.” Psalm 16:11. Join us in this transformative journey to enrich your life and your relationships, one episode at a time.

title: Mission Revival - Outpost Centers International
description: Hosted by Steve Dickman and Michelle Song, this series brings to light the desperate need for outreach in all areas of the world. While Seventh-day Adventism has made it's mark, there are still areas of the world that have yet to be touched. This series will provide you with helpful ministry tips and inspiring testimonies of those who have answered the call to outreach ministry. "And the Good News about the Kingdom will be preached throughout the whole world, so that all nations will hear it; and then the end will come.." (Matthew 24:14).

title: Cracking The Genesis Code
description: On the surface the book of Genesis appears to be a mere collection of ancient stories.  But don't be fooled!  Beneath the external simplicity lies a secret code which, when broken, reveals in no uncertain terms what will happen in the future.  This series reveals the intimate connection between the first book of the Bible, Genesis, and the last book, Revelation.  Don't miss this life changing experience!

title: Jesus for Asia Faith Camp
description: With every missionary stepping into the mission field, stories and miracles are bound to happen! Join us in this inspiring series as missionaries working with Jesus For Asia share those amazing stories and miracles! Whether you're looking for inspiration, a boost of faith, or simply a good story, this series will leave you moved and motivated.

title: The Sanctuary - Eric Walsh
description: "And let them make me a sanctuary; that I may dwell among them." (Exodus 25:8) This nine-part series hosted by Eric Walsh will help illuminate the lessons of the sanctuary that were and still are intended to bring us closer to our Lord.

title: It Is Written Canada
description: Mike and René Lemon are the hosts for It Is Written Canada, a nationwide television ministry that spotlights the life-transforming power of trusting God’s Word.

title: The Virtual Family
description: Consider the typical American family; our obession with technology, entertainment and the workplace. We are often left feeling like we only have little time for family and God... Is there hope for our next generation? In this series presented by Bradley Booth, director of The Storytellers ministry, we will learn through the template God has given in Scripture and the Spirit of Prophecy, how we can find success and hope for the families of today and the future.

title: The Best of I'd Like to Know
description: The Best of I'd Like to Know revisits some of the series’ most compelling questions about the Bible, faith, and Christian life. Through Scripture-based answers and thoughtful discussion, these selected episodes invite you to discover timeless biblical truths, and deepen your understanding of God’s Word.

title: The Unknown God
description: The Unknown God is a thought-provoking series that dives deep into the Gospel of John to uncover the true characer of God; challenging common misconceptions and misinterpretations. Many believe they know God, but often these perceptions are built on surface-level knowledge or negative past experiences, leaving the true essense of His nature obscured. We invite you to join Dale Leamon in this series and discover enlightening insights on God's pure love, justice and mercy.

title: Living Well
description: "So whether you eat or drink, or whatever you do, do it all for the glory of God." (1 Corinthians 10:31) How can we use food to glorify God? When we honor our bodies by fueling them with the natural God-given foods presented in the Bible, we feel capable to carry out the mission God has for our lives. This series, featuring many educated hosts, presents step-by-step demonstrations for delicious vegetarian/vegan recipes that will help you enjoy your food and live well!

title: Belt of Truth - The Media Mind
description: In today's world a huge percentage of the population has developed a media addiction in some form or another. With social media, video games and television, there seems to be no end to the media content we can consume. But what are the negative affects of this overuse? How can we fight against the media attacks on our communities.. families.. our humanity? In this series, Scott Ritsema will discuss the spiritual controversy behind media and how we can filter out the dangers.

title: Secrets of Pentecost
description: What comes to your mind when you hear the word ‘Pentecost’? Most people think of a mighty rushing wind, tongues of fire and strange languages. But there is much more to Pentecost than this. In this 10-part series Pastor Bohr explains the profound meaning of the Pentecostal events in heaven and on earth and their significance for today.

title: God's Prophetic Chain
description: History is not composed of a series of disconnected and haphazard events. Rather, it is carefully choreographed chain of events that were predicted millenia ago by God. In this series Pastor Bohr traces God's great prophec chain, link by link, from Ancient Babylon to the end of time. Special attention is dedicated to the end-time conflict and the glorious deliverance of God's faithful remnant. You will be amazed at the predictive preciosion of Bible prophecy and your faith in the Master of history will grow exponentially.

title: Unlocking Bible Prophecies
description: Chaos is increasing worldwide. Global disasters are increasing at an alarming rate. What does it all mean? What does the future hold? Join Cami Oetman on a journey for answers in Unlocking Bible Prophecies. Through her travels around the world, Cami has come face to face with real-life struggles, but in the midst of them, she has found miracles of hope.

title: Amazing Facts: Bible Answers Live
description: Bible Answers Live is a live call-in radio program where callers can have their questions answered directly from the Bible. A dynamic 60-minute radio broadcast in which listeners like you are the program! You’ll get accurate, biblical answers to difficult Bible questions.

description: "So whether you eat or drink, or whatever you do, do it all for the glory of God." (1 Corinthians 10:31) How can we use food to glorify God? description: Filmed at visually stunning locations, join Jim and Janice as they take you on an amazing journey. Every episode delivers engaging, simple-to-understand wisdom combined with down-to-earth Biblical insights.

title: Heart Wise Ministries - The Heart of Health
description: The Heart of Health is a call in health program providing viewers with an opportunity to call in and get free medical advice from guests who practice medicine every day.

title: The Mystery Revealed - Eric Wilson
description: Many Christians today, even in our own churches, are struggling with doubt, sin, and a longing to be free. But God has promised freedom through His Son, Jesus. Join us as we study God’s Word together and learn how to believe for true salvation, freedom, healing, and restoration by claiming His promises through faith.

title: Who's Rockin The House
description: You may be surprised to learn that Satan once served as the choir director in Heaven. Since his fall, he has used his musical gifts as a powerful tool to influence and corrupt humanity. Tragically, even followers of Christ have begun to blend the sacred with the profane. As the end approaches, don’t be deceived by the counterfeit, emotionally charged worship experiences that Satan is orchestrating to lead many astray before the close of probation and the return of Christ. By studying Biblical principles, you can gain the spiritual discernment needed to distinguish between worship that is truly pleasing to God—both in personal and corporate worship—and that which is not.

description: Being Woman is an empowering educational series that delves into the intricacies of women's health. We hope you find encouragment to embrace every health journey with faith and reverence.

title: Silvia Abril y Ruth Lorenzo
description: Al cielo con Silvia Abril y Ruth Lorenzo. ‘Al cielo con ella’ regresa con dos invitadas de lujo: Silvia Abril y Ruth Lorenzo. En este primer programa de 2026, Henar Álvarez recibirá también a Ana Morgade como colaboradora y al meteorólogo Martín Barreiro, que hará una predicción muy especial. Ana Morgade,Lamine Thior,Rubén Avilés,Laura del Val.

title: Ana Peleteiro y Luján Argüelles
description: Al cielo con Ana Peleteiro y Luján Argüelles. Henar pone el foco en el tema de la semana, la investigación a Julio Iglesias y cómo eso ha destapado comportamientos intolerables en la televisión del pasado. Como invitadas, la atleta Ana Peleteiro y la presentadora Luján Argüelles. Ana Morgade,Lamine Thior,Rubén Avilés,Laura del Val.

title: Paloma San Basilio y Manolo García
description: Al cielo con Manolo García y Paloma San Basilio. Dos leyendas de la música visitan esta semana a Henar Álvarez en el plató de ‘Al cielo con ella’ . Paloma San Basilio presenta su obra de teatro ‘Dulcinea’ y Manolo García, su nuevo disco en solitario y la gira con El último de la fila. Además, Lamine Thior se estrena como nuevo colaborador del programa Ana Morgade,Lamine Thior,Rubén Avilés,Laura del Val.

title: Víctor Manuel y Valeria Vegas
description: Al cielo con Víctor Manuel y Valeria Vegas. Esta semana, cada invitado viene con nuevo trabajo bajo el brazo: Víctor Manuel, con disco; Valeria Vegas, con libro; y Toni Acosta, con una loca sección. Ana Morgade,Lamine Thior,Rubén Avilés,Laura del Val.

title: Álex de la Iglesia y Mónica Ojeda
description: Al cielo con... Álex de la Iglesia y Mónica Ojeda. ‘Al cielo con ella’ celebra Halloween con un especial lleno de terror y dos invitados de lujo: el director Álex de la Iglesia y la escritora Mónica Ojeda. Ana Morgade,Lamine Thior,Rubén Avilés,Laura del Val.

title: Rosa M. Calaf, Pablo Puyol y Dora Postigo
description: Al cielo con… Rosa María Calaf y Pablo Puyol. Henar Álvarez recibe a la periodista Rosa María Calaf y al actor Pablo Puyol en esta entrega en la que además comentará la polémica de las muñecas sexuales con forma de bebé que se vendían en una plataforma online. Ana Morgade,Lamine Thior,Rubén Avilés,Laura del Val.

title: Asier Etxeandia y María Guerra
description: Al cielo con… Asier Etxeandia y María Guerra. Henar se pregunta por qué tantos hombres se sienten intimidados si sus parejas triunfan. Visitan el programa el actor Asier Etxeandia, la periodista María Guerra y Ana Morgade vuelve con su sección. . Ana Morgade,Lamine Thior,Rubén Avilés,Laura del Val.

title: Maruja Torres y Maya Hansen
description: Al cielo con... Maruja Torres y Maya Hansen. Henar se hace eco de la tendencia de algunos a echar de menos tiempos pasados. Para ello hace un retrato de la vida de las mujeres hace 50 años. Maruja Torres, una de las voces más lúcidas y sarcásticas del periodismo, hace un repaso por su trayectoria laboral. También visita el programa la diseñadora Maya Hansen. Ana Morgade,Lamine Thior,Rubén Avilés,Laura del Val.

title: Alba Flores y Amparo Larrañaga
description: Al cielo con... Alba Flores y Amparo Larrañaga. Henar Álvarez hace un alegato en contra de los señores que tocan los cuerpos de mujeres sin permiso en presencia de las cámaras de televisión. Las actrices Alba Flores, que presenta un documental homenaje a su padre, y Amparo Larrañaga, con casi 50 años en el teatro, son las invitadas. Ana Morgade,Lamine Thior,Rubén Avilés,Laura del Val.

title: Eduardo Casanova y Elena Anaya
description: Al cielo con... Eduardo Casanova y Elena Anaya. Henar repasa la nueva skin routine de moda: la de la vagina. Eduardo Casanova presenta la serie 'Silencio', que visibiliza el estigma de portar el VIH. La actriz Elena Anaya habla de su nuevo trabajo, 'Innato'. Lanzamos a la cómica Laura del Val a las alfombras rojas y Chica Sobresalto nos canta "Amor". Ana Morgade,Lamine Thior,Rubén Avilés,Laura del Val.

title: Elvira Lindo, Vania Arana y Victoria Martín
description: Al cielo con… Elvira Lindo, Vania Arana y Victoria Martín. Henar Álvarez recibe a Vania Arana, presidenta y portavoz del sindicato de las Kellys de Barcelona y la escritora Elvira Lindo. Ana Morgade,Lamine Thior,Rubén Avilés,Laura del Val.

title: Chenoa y Raquel Peláez
description: Al cielo con… Chenoa y Raquel Peláez. 'Al cielo con ella' viene esta semana con cuatro mujeres poderosas. Al frente, Henar Álvarez y a su lado la cantante Chenoa, que presenta nuevo single, y la periodista Raquel Peláez radiografiando la figura del pijo. Bianca Kovacs reclamará dos Goyas y Tomás Fuentes hará… lo que le dejen. Ana Morgade,Lamine Thior,Rubén Avilés,Laura del Val.

title: Joana Pastrana, Marta Marcè y Elvira Lindo
description: Al cielo con… Joana Pastrana, Marta Marcè y Elvira Lindo. Henar Álvarez recibe a la campeona del mundo de boxeo Joana Pastrana, que se ha reinventado como actriz, a la nutricionista Marta Marcè y a la escritora Elvira Lindo. Ana Morgade,Lamine Thior,Rubén Avilés,Laura del Val.

title: Zahara y Juan Sanguino
description: Al cielo con… Zahara y Juan Sanguino. Repasamos los grandes hits de la cultura pop patria con el periodista Juan Sanguino. La cantante Zahara estrena "Tus Michis", un canto a la amistad. Tomás Fuentes pide a los astros que arrojen luz a las últimas rupturas amorosas. Todo bajo la batuta de la reina, Henar Álvarez. Ana Morgade,Lamine Thior,Rubén Avilés,Laura del Val.

title: Paco León y Toni Acosta
description: Al cielo con… Paco León y Toni Acosta. Especial Navidad con Toni Acosta y Paco León. Victoria Martín trae el manual de la perfecta famosa. Y Henar Álvarez nos cantará un villancico. Ana Morgade,Lamine Thior,Rubén Avilés,Laura del Val.

title: Abril Zamora y Elaine Vilar Madruga
description: Al cielo con… Abril Zamora y Elaine Vilar Madruga. Despedimos el año con Henar y sus “chicas malas”, la directora y actriz Abril Zamora, la escritora Elaine Vilar Madruga y el cómico Tomàs Fuentes Ana Morgade,Lamine Thior,Rubén Avilés,Laura del Val.

title: It's a Mann's World
description: Multitalented entertainers David and Tamela Mann are known mostly for their stage and screen collaborations with producer Tyler Perry ("Meet the Browns"). "It's a Mann's World" provides fans a view of the couple behind the camera -- at home, attending exclusive events, and spending time with famous friends. The hourlong episodes show how David and Tamela balance being celebrities, entrepreneurs and parents to four adult children while maintaining their marriage of 20-plus years.

title: The Bridge on the River Kwai
description: A British POW colonel (Alec Guinness) orders his men to build their Japanese captor (Sessue Hayakawa) a railway bridge in the jungle.

title: The Sound of Music
description: A tuneful, heartwarming story, it is based on the real life story of the Von Trapp Family singers, one of the world's best-known concert groups in the era immediately preceding World War II. Julie Andrews plays the role of Maria, the tomboyish postulant at an Austrian abbey who becomes a governess in the home of a widowed naval captain with seven children, and brings a new love of life and music into the home.

title: Hour of the Gun
description: While the Earp brothers may have won the gunfight at the O.K. Corral, they didn't escape unscathed for long. Seeking revenge over their fallen comrades, members of the Clanton gang go after the Earp family, gunning down both Virgil and Morgan Earp. But they don't succeed at getting Wyatt (James Garner). Now it's his turn to seek revenge. With Doc Holliday (Jason Robards) by his side, Wyatt forms a posse, and they won't rest until every member of the Clanton gang is dead.

title: I Am Sartana Your Angel of Death
description: A bank that was thought to be impenetrable is robbed by a man wearing the trademark Sartana cloak.

title: Magic Mike XXL
description: It's been three years since Mike Lane's (Channing Tatum) retirement from stripping, but the former dancer misses the excitement and feeling of being on stage. Most of all, though, he misses the best friends that he ever had, the crew known as the Kings of Tampa. Opportunity comes knocking when the guys look him up as they travel to Myrtle Beach, S.C., for a stripper convention. With the promise of outrageous fun, a reinvigorated Mike can't resist the chance to join in and take it off again.

title: Jobs
description: In 1976, college dropout Steve Jobs (Ashton Kutcher) and technical wizard Steve Wozniak (Josh Gad) spark a revolution with the invention of the Apple computer, built in the garage of Jobs' parents. In 1976, college dropout Steve Jobs (Ashton Kutcher) and technical wizard Steve Wozniak (Josh Gad) spark a revolution with the invention of the Apple computer, built in the garage of Jobs' parents.

title: Red, White & Royal Blue
description: The son of the U.S. president sparks a feud with Britain's prince.

title: Big Fish
description: When Edward Bloom (Albert Finney) becomes ill, his son, William (Billy Crudup), travels to be with him. William has a strained relationship with Edward because his father has always told exaggerated stories about his life, and William thinks he's never really told the truth. Even on his deathbed, Edward recounts fantastical anecdotes. When William, who is a journalist, starts to investigate his father's tales, he begins to understand the man and his penchant for storytelling.

title: The Peanuts Movie
description: Life always seems complicated for good ol' Charlie Brown (Noah Schnapp), the boy who always tries his best against seemingly impossible odds. When the Little Red-Haired Girl moves into his neighborhood, Charlie Brown develops a crush on her. Meanwhile, his best friend Snoopy embarks on an epic adventure in a fantasy world. As a World War I flying ace, the lovable beagle pursues his nemesis, the Red Baron, while also trying to win the heart of a beautiful poodle named Fifi (Kristin Chenoweth).

title: Annabelle: Creation
description: Former toy maker Sam Mullins and his wife, Esther, are happy to welcome a nun and six orphaned girls into their California farmhouse. Years earlier, the couple's 7-year-old daughter Annabelle died in a tragic car accident. Terror soon strikes when one child sneaks into a forbidden room and finds a seemingly innocent doll that appears to have a life of its own.

title: The Next Three Days
description: Life for John and Lara Brennan (Russell Crowe, Elizabeth Banks) is miserable after she is convicted of a murder she says she did not commit. Three years later while struggling with the demands of work and raising his son alone, John is still trying to establish her innocence. When her final appeal is rejected, Lara becomes suicidal, forcing John to exercise the only option he has left: Break her out of prison.

title: Magic Mike
description: By day, Mike (Channing Tatum) makes ends meet any way he can -- handyman jobs, detailing cars or designing furniture. But nighttime is when Mike really gets to display his many talents: He's the hot headliner in an all-male revue. Mike sees potential in a 19-year-old he dubs the Kid (Alex Pettyfer), takes the teen under his wing and instructs him in the tricks of the trade. However, Mike learns there's a downside to the stripper lifestyle when it threatens his romance with the Kid's sister.

title: Shall We Dance?
description: Despite having a great career and a loving family, lawyer John Clark (Richard Gere) is missing something in his life as he meanders listlessly from day to day. On his commute back home one night, Clark notices a stunning woman (Jennifer Lopez) in a dance studio and decides on a whim to join a class for ballroom dancing. While Clark finds a new spark in his life, his wife, Beverly (Susan Sarandon), grows suspicious of his frequent absences, since he decides to keep his dancing a secret.

title: X-Men: Dark Phoenix
description: The X-Men face their most formidable and powerful foe when one of their own, Jean Grey, starts to spiral out of control. During a rescue mission in outer space, Jean is nearly killed when she's hit by a mysterious cosmic force. Once she returns home, this force not only makes her infinitely more powerful, but far more unstable. The X-Men must now band together to save her soul and battle aliens that want to use Grey's new abilities to rule the galaxy.

title: Ike: Countdown to D-Day
description: Gen. Dwight D. Eisenhower (Tom Selleck) faces monumental decisions in the 90 days leading to the Allied invasion of Normandy in 1944.

title: Forrest Gump
description: Slow-witted Forrest Gump (Tom Hanks) has never thought of himself as disadvantaged, and thanks to his supportive mother (Sally Field), he leads anything but a restricted life. Whether dominating on the gridiron as a college football star, fighting in Vietnam or captaining a shrimp boat, Forrest inspires people with his childlike optimism. But one person Forrest cares about most may be the most difficult to save -- his childhood love, the sweet but troubled Jenny (Robin Wright).

title: Sister Act
description: When lively lounge singer Deloris Van Cartier (Whoopi Goldberg) sees her mobster beau, Vince LaRocca (Harvey Keitel), commit murder, she is relocated for her protection. Set up in the guise of a nun in a California convent, Deloris proceeds to upend the quiet lives of the resident sisters. In an effort to keep her out of trouble, they assign Deloris to the convent's choir, an ensemble that she soon turns into a vibrant and soulful act that gains widespread attention.

title: Holiday Inn
description: In this Irving Berlin musical, Jim (Bing Crosby) and Lila are members of a performing trio who plan to quit and run a country hotel. When Lila says she has fallen in love with the dancer in the act, Ted (Fred Astaire), Jim leaves town with a broken heart. After turning the inn into a holidays-only live entertainment venue, Jim winds up booking -- and falling for -- Linda (Marjorie Reynolds). But when Ted shows up at the place after being dumped by Lila, he too sets his sights on beautiful Linda.

title: Yellow Hair and the Fortress of Gold
description: The Pecos Kid (Ken Roberson) and a blonde (Laurene Landon) race a Mexican colonel (Luis Lorento) and renegades to gold guarded by Indians.

title: M*A*S*H
description: Hip Army surgeons Hawkeye (Donald Sutherland) and Trapper John (Elliott Gould) make their own rules in the chaos of Korea.

title: Mrs. Doubtfire
description: An unemployed actor disguises himself as an elderly nanny in order to spend more time with his estranged family.

title: Support Your Local Gunfighter
description: When traveling con man Latigo Smith (James Garner) drifts into a small Western town, he decides to take advantage of a local rivalry between gold-mining factions. Recruiting the shifty Jug May (Jack Elam) to pose as a notorious gunfighter, Smith sets his scheme in motion, while also taking time to romance the lovely Patience Barton (Suzanne Pleshette). However, after his ruse is uncovered, Smith incurs the wrath of the real hired gun, among others, leading to a big shoot-out.

title: The Map of Tiny Perfect Things
description: Two teens develop a budding romance while stuck in an endless time loop.

title: Measure of a Man
description: A teen develops a bond with a Wall Street executive while learning to stand up to bullies during one life-changing summer.

title: Undertone
description: The host of a popular paranormal podcast is sent hidden messages within anonymous recordings, unleashing a demonic presence that is impossible to escape.

title: As Good as It Gets
description: Melvin Udall (Jack Nicholson) is an obsessive-compulsive writer of romantic fiction who's rude to everyone he meets, including his gay neighbor Simon (Greg Kinnear), but when he has to look after Simon's dog, he begins to soften and, if still not completely over his problems, finds he can conduct a relationship with the only waitress (Helen Hunt) at the local diner who'll serve him.

title: Magic Mike XXL
description: It's been three years since Mike Lane's (Channing Tatum) retirement from stripping, but the former dancer misses the excitement and feeling of being on stage. Most of all, though, he misses the best friends that he ever had, the crew known as the Kings of Tampa. Opportunity comes knocking when the guys look him up as they travel to Myrtle Beach, S.C., for a stripper convention. With the promise of outrageous fun, a reinvigorated Mike can't resist the chance to join in and take it off again.

title: Drive Angry
description: Thrown into hell for his crimes, brutal felon John Milton escapes from the fiery pit after cultists murder his daughter and take her baby. Intent on rescuing the child, Milton joins forces with a waitress, who gives him her ex-lover's fire-red muscle car. In it, the two pursue the cult leader, who plans to sacrifice the infant and unleash hell on Earth. However, the hunters become the hunted when Satan sends his merciless henchman to drag Milton back.

title: A Song Is Born
description: A group of music professors, including Frisbee (Danny Kaye) and Magenbruch (Benny Goodman), are writing an encyclopedia of music. A pair of window washers introduces the duo to a pioneering musical form called jazz. Frisbee and Magenbruch start going to nightclubs to hear the new sound and become involved with club singer Honey Swanson (Virginia Mayo), who is running from police because they want her to inform on her gangster boyfriend, Tony Crow (Steve Cochran).

title: The Peanuts Movie
description: Life always seems complicated for good ol' Charlie Brown (Noah Schnapp), the boy who always tries his best against seemingly impossible odds. When the Little Red-Haired Girl moves into his neighborhood, Charlie Brown develops a crush on her. Meanwhile, his best friend Snoopy embarks on an epic adventure in a fantasy world. As a World War I flying ace, the lovable beagle pursues his nemesis, the Red Baron, while also trying to win the heart of a beautiful poodle named Fifi (Kristin Chenoweth).

title: Apache Fury
description: A judge encounters a man he once wronged after an Apache attack forces him, his fiancée and their fellow stagecoach passengers to take refuge at a rest stop.

title: Up in the Air
description: An idea from a young, new co-worker (Anna Kendrick) would put an end to the constant travel of corporate downsizer Ryan Bingham (George Clooney), so he takes her on a tour to demonstrate the importance of face-to-face meetings with those they must fire. While mentoring his colleague, he arranges hookups with another frequent-flier (Vera Farmiga), and his developing feelings for the woman prompt him to see others in a new light.

title: Desk Set
description: Bunny Watson (Katharine Hepburn) is a library reference clerk stuck in a dead-end relationship with a boring television executive (Gig Young). Her life is thrown into turmoil when computer expert Richard Sumner (Spencer Tracy) enters it. He has been assigned with automating her department, and she is fearful that Summers' new computers will automate her out of a job. She despises him at first, but eventually each of the two start to fall for the other's charms and strong personalities.

title: He's Just Not That Into You
description: Baltimore-based friends and lovers, all in their 20s and 30s, try to navigate their way through the complexities of modern relationships. Beth (Jennifer Aniston) wants commitment from Neil (Ben Affleck), who sees nothing wrong with the status quo. Gigi (Ginnifer Goodwin) is tired of waiting by the phone, while Mary (Drew Barrymore) has a slew of supportive male friends, none of whom are straight. Meanwhile, Janine has trust issues with her husband, who can't trust himself around Anna.

title: Mother Mary
description: Long-buried wounds rise to the surface when a pop star reunites with her best friend on the eve of her comeback.

title: Beautiful Wave
description: A New York teen (Aimee Teegarden) discovers a family secret while spending the summer in California with her estranged grandmother (Patricia Richardson).

title: Samaritan
description: Thirteen-year-old Sam Cleary suspects that his mysterious and reclusive neighbor, Mr. Smith, is actually a legend hiding in plain sight. Twenty-five years ago, Granite City's superpowered vigilante, Samaritan, was reported dead after a fiery warehouse battle with his rival, Nemesis. Most believe he perished in the fire, but some, like Sam, have hope that he's still alive. With crime now on the rise, Sam makes it his mission to coax Samaritan out of hiding to save the city from ruin.

title: Breakheart Pass
description: When diphtheria breaks out at Fort Humboldt, a train is dispatched with medical supplies and relief troops. Also on board are Utah's governor (Richard Crenna), his mistress (Jill Ireland), a marshal (Ben Johnson) and his prisoner, outlaw John Deakin (Charles Bronson). As the train passes through the mountains, soldiers go missing, telegraph lines are cut and it's discovered that there is no epidemic. There's a conspiracy afoot, and it's up to Deakin, actually a federal agent, to expose it.

title: Cheaper by the Dozen
description: Tom and Kate Baker compromise their careers to raise 12 children. Tom coaches a high-school football team, while Kate has retired from journalism to raise the family. Things change when Tom is offered a college coaching job in a new city at the same time a publisher buys Kate's parenting memoir. After moving, Kate goes on a book tour, leaving Tom in charge of the children. The children, already unhappy about relocating, plunge the household into chaos.

title: Silver Streak
description: A Los Angeleno (Gene Wilder) gets help from a petty thief (Richard Pryor) to rescue a woman (Jill Clayburgh) from killers on the same train to Chicago.

title: Love & Basketball
description: Monica (Sanaa Lathan) and Quincy (Omar Epps) are two childhood friends who both aspire to be professional basketball players. Quincy, whose father, Zeke (Dennis Haysbert), plays for the Los Angeles Clippers, is a natural talent and a born leader. Monica is ferociously competitive but sometimes becomes overly emotional on the court. Over the years, the two begin to fall for each other, but their separate paths to basketball stardom threaten to pull them apart.

title: Hey Amigo! A Toast to Your Death
description: A team of bandits carries out a big heist in a Texan village and subsequently runs away to a hideout. However, it is only a matter of time before the bandits get hunted down.

title: Mrs. Doubtfire
description: An unemployed actor disguises himself as an elderly nanny in order to spend more time with his estranged family.

title: Roxanne
description: In this modern take on Edmond Rostand's classic play "Cyrano de Bergerac," C. D. Bales (Steve Martin) is the witty, intelligent and brave fire chief of a small Pacific Northwest town who, due to the size of his enormous nose, declines to pursue the girl of his dreams, lovely Roxanne Kowalski (Daryl Hannah). Instead, when his shy underling Chris McConnell (Rick Rossovich) becomes smitten with Roxanne, Bales feeds the handsome young man the words of love to win her heart.

title: Machete Kills
description: The president recruits ex-Federale Machete to take down an eccentric arms dealer who plans to spread war and anarchy throughout the world.

title: Maximum Conviction
description: Tom, former black ops operative, and his partner Manning are forced to defend a prison when a force of mercenaries assaults the facility to find two women.

title: Reveille With Beverly
description: As the substitute host on a morning radio program, former switchboard operator Beverly Ross (Ann Miller) becomes a local sensation when she changes the format to hot boogie-woogie. Wanting to meet the mysterious disc jockey, millionaire Barry Lang (William Wright) switches identities with his chauffeur, Andy Adams (Dick Purcell), so Barry can woo her without revealing his wealth. When Beverly's new job is jeopardized, they team up with soldiers at a nearby military base to save her show.

title: The Big Short
description: In 2008, Wall Street guru Michael Burry realizes that a number of subprime home loans are in danger of defaulting. Burry bets against the housing market by throwing more than $1 billion of his investors' money into credit default swaps. His actions attract the attention of banker Jared Vennett (Ryan Gosling), hedge-fund specialist Mark Baum (Steve Carell) and other greedy opportunists. Together, these men make a fortune by taking full advantage of the impending economic collapse in America.

title: Ground Control
description: An air-traffic controller (Kiefer Sutherland) quits after a plane crash but, years later, goes to help an airport that is in the path of a terrible storm.

title: Morbius
description: Dangerously ill with a rare blood disorder and determined to save others from the same fate, Dr. Morbius attempts a desperate gamble. While at first it seems to be a radical success, a darkness inside of him is soon unleashed.

title: Materialists
description: A young, ambitious New York City matchmaker finds herself torn between the perfect match and her imperfect ex.

title: Shotgun Wedding
description: Darcy and Tom gather their families for a destination wedding, but the ceremony gets put on hold when gunmen take everyone hostage. Now, they must do everything they can to save their loved ones -- if they don't wind up killing each other first.

title: You're Dating a Narcissist!
description: A psychology professor who has a knack for spotting narcissists flies across the country to prove that the man her daughter is marrying is a fraud.

title: The Sound of Music
description: A tuneful, heartwarming story, it is based on the real life story of the Von Trapp Family singers, one of the world's best-known concert groups in the era immediately preceding World War II. Julie Andrews plays the role of Maria, the tomboyish postulant at an Austrian abbey who becomes a governess in the home of a widowed naval captain with seven children, and brings a new love of life and music into the home.

title: Doin' It
description: Moonlighting as a high-school substitute teacher, a 30-year-old virgin gets in over her head when she's assigned to teach sex education.

title: Quinto: Fighting Proud
description: The Blackie gang pulls off the perfect bank heist. It's unknown who took the money.

title: Major Dundee
description: During the end of the Civil War, Major Dundee guards Confederate prisoners, Union deserters and ordinary hard-bitten criminals in a remote fort. When Apaches attack the fort and make off with three children, Dundee must set up a posse including Confederates, who face a choice between joining up or being shot. The feud between Dundee and Tyreen is also heated up by a sultry Mexican widow.

title: Battle of Britain
description: At a seminal moment in World War II, British Air Chief Marshal Sir Hugh Dowding (Laurence Olivier) must rally his outnumbered pilots against Hitler's feared Luftwaffe. Besieged by German bombing runs, the Brits counter with an aggressive air campaign of their own. Within months, the Nazis find themselves on the run, thanks to Dowding's tactical genius and the work of talented squadron leaders (Michael Caine, Christopher Plummer) and other brave patriots.

title: Hollywood Hotel
description: After losing a coveted role in an upcoming film to another actress, screen queen Mona Marshall (Lola Lane) protests by refusing to appear at her current movie's premiere. Her agent discovers struggling actress Virginia Stanton (Rosemary Lane) -- an exact match for Mona -- and sends her to the premiere instead, with young musician Ronnie Bowers (Dick Powell). After various mishaps, including a case of mistaken identity, Ronnie and Virginia struggle to find success in Hollywood.

title: To Be or Not to Be
description: Married members (Mel Brooks, Anne Bancroft) of a Polish troupe outwit Nazis for the Underground on the eve of World War II.

title: Senior Moment
description: After drag racing his vintage convertible around Palm Springs, Calif., a retired NASA test pilot loses his license. Forced to take public transportation, he meets Caroline and learns to navigate love and life again.

title: Dangerous
description: An ex-con and reformed sociopath battles a band of heavily armed mercenaries as he tries to uncover the truth behind his brother's mysterious death.

title: Lulu on the Bridge
description: A seemingly magic stone leads an aging, injured musician (Harvey Keitel) into love with a young, aspiring actress (Mira Sorvino).

title: Cheaper by the Dozen
description: Tom and Kate Baker compromise their careers to raise 12 children. Tom coaches a high-school football team, while Kate has retired from journalism to raise the family. Things change when Tom is offered a college coaching job in a new city at the same time a publisher buys Kate's parenting memoir. After moving, Kate goes on a book tour, leaving Tom in charge of the children. The children, already unhappy about relocating, plunge the household into chaos.

title: X-Men: Dark Phoenix
description: The X-Men face their most formidable and powerful foe when one of their own, Jean Grey, starts to spiral out of control. During a rescue mission in outer space, Jean is nearly killed when she's hit by a mysterious cosmic force. Once she returns home, this force not only makes her infinitely more powerful, but far more unstable. The X-Men must now band together to save her soul and battle aliens that want to use Grey's new abilities to rule the galaxy.

title: Rock the Kasbah
description: After discovering a talented teenage singer (Leem Lubany) in Afghanistan, a washed-up American music manager (Bill Murray) makes it his mission to land her a spot on the television show "Afghan Star.".

title: Catch Me if You Can
description: Frank Abagnale, Jr. works as a doctor, a lawyer and as a co-pilot for a major airline, all before his 18th birthday. A master of deception, he is a brilliant forger, whose skill gives him his first real claim to fame. At the age of 17, Frank Abagnale, Jr. becomes the most successful bank robber in the history of the U.S. FBI Agent Carl Hanratty makes it his prime mission to capture Frank and bring him to justice, but Frank is always one step ahead of him.

title: Blue Valentine
description: Dean (Ryan Gosling) and Cindy (Michelle Williams) live a quiet life in a modest neighborhood. To the casual observer, everything appears normal, if a bit subdued. But a closer examination reveals a couple caught in a downward spiral. They appear to have the world at their feet at the outset of the relationship. However, his lack of ambition and her retreat into self-absorption cause potentially irreversible cracks in their marriage.

title: Tony
description: A 19-year-old Anthony Bourdain stumbles into the chaotic world of a Provincetown restaurant kitchen, setting off a summer that will shape the course of his life. Tony captures the sun-soaked feeling of summer in this origin story of the voice that defined a generation. Directed by Matt Johnson and anchored by Dominic Sessa, Antonio Banderas and a rowdy ensemble.

title: Tom Clancy's Without Remorse
description: Seeking justice for the murder of his pregnant wife, an elite Navy SEAL uncovers a covert plot that threatens to engulf the United States and Russia in an all-out war.

title: The Friend
description: New York City writer Iris finds her comfortable, solitary life thrown into disarray after her closest friend and mentor bequeaths her a Great Dane named Apollo. The huge dog immediately creates practical problems for Iris, from furniture destruction to eviction notices, as well as more existential ones. Yet as Iris finds herself unexpectedly bonding with Apollo, she begins to come to terms with her past, and her own creative inner life.

title: Three Ruthless Ones
description: Three men take different paths in pursuit of their father's killer.

title: Ship Ahoy
description: Tallulah Winters (Eleanor Powell), a Broadway dancer, is inadvertently involved in a spy plot when she agrees to carry a vital piece of equipment on a cruise to Rio. The spy ringleader got the idea of using an entertainer from a story by eccentric dime magazine writer Merton K. Kibble (Red Skelton) -- whose friend Skip Owens (Bert Lahr) has convinced him to take the cruise as well. Tallulah and Merton hit it off, until Tallulah overhears him discussing a plot for a story and thinks he is a spy.

title: And Now... Ladies and Gentlemen
description: A jewel thief (Jeremy Irons) and a singer (Patricia Kaas) who both want to break free of the past meet by chance in Morocco.

title: Turtle Tale
description: Rafi, Hank and Goliath, a trio of talking turtles, are living the good life at a Florida animal park. But when vandals kidnap Hank, it's up to Rafi and Goliath to find their missing friend.

title: Planet Action
description: A look at how celebrities are stepping up to make a difference in the world and hopefully inspiring others to do the same.

title: You're Dating a Narcissist!
description: A psychology professor who has a knack for spotting narcissists flies across the country to prove that the man her daughter is marrying is a fraud.

Julie Andrews plays the role of Maria, the tomboyish postulant at an Austrian abbey who becomes a governess in the home of a widowed naval captain with seven children, and brings a new love of life and music into the home.

title: The Hot Rock
description: A thief (Robert Redford), his brother-in-law (George Segal) and their two helpers botch a diamond caper in New York.

title: Planet Action
description: A look at how celebrities are stepping up to make a difference in the world and hopefully inspiring others to do the same.

title: Troop Beverly Hills
description: With her marriage breaking up, Beverly Hills housewife Phyllis Nefler boosts her self-esteem by leading a local troop of Wilderness Girls. Although Phyllis' version of roughing it is spending the night at the Beverly Hills Hotel, that suits her privileged troop members just fine. Unfortunately, when Phyllis falls afoul of a rival leader, the girls are threatened with having their group dissolved -- unless they can prove their wilderness skills at the annual jamboree.

title: Birdman or (The Unexpected Virtue of Ignorance)
description: Former cinema superhero Riggan Thomson (Michael Keaton) is mounting an ambitious Broadway production that he hopes will breathe new life into his stagnant career. It's risky, but he hopes that his creative gamble will prove that he's a real artist and not just a washed-up movie star. As opening night approaches, a castmate is injured, forcing Riggan to hire an actor (Edward Norton) who is guaranteed to shake things up. Meanwhile, Riggan must deal with his girlfriend, daughter and ex-wife.

title: Bridget Jones: The Edge of Reason
description: The sequel to "Bridget Jones's Diary" finds Bridget (Renée Zellweger) working as a TV host and still dating barrister Mark (Colin Firth). But Bridget is jealous of the time Mark spends with a co-worker (Jacinda Barrett), and, despite a vacation meant to smooth things over, ends their relationship. On assignment in Thailand, she has a dalliance with her disreputable ex, Daniel (Hugh Grant), and is temporarily jailed on the false accusation of drug smuggling, before Mark comes to the rescue.

title: The Gun That Won the West
description: Superior Springfield rifles help scouts (Dennis Morgan, Richard Denning) and the cavalry get forts built in Wyoming.

title: Secret to INDEPENDENT Living!
description: No more slips or falls! Installation in just ONE Day!

title: The Tomorrow War
description: Soldiers and civilians travel to the year 2051 to join a global war against a deadly alien species.

title: Double Jeopardy
description: Framed for the murder of her husband, Libby Parsons (Ashley Judd) survives the long years in prison with two burning desires sustaining her -- finding her son and solving the mystery that destroyed her once-happy life. Standing between her and her quest, however, is her parole officer, Travis Lehman (Tommy Lee Jones). Libby poses a challenge to the cynical officer, one that forces him to face up to his own failings while pitting him against his superiors and law enforcement colleagues.

title: The Wolf of Wall Street
description: In 1987, Jordan Belfort takes an entry-level job at a Wall Street brokerage firm. By the early 1990s, while still in his 20s, Belfort founds his own firm, Stratton Oakmont. Together with his trusted lieutenant and a merry band of brokers, Belfort makes a huge fortune by defrauding wealthy investors out of millions. However, while Belfort and his cronies partake in a hedonistic brew of sex, drugs and thrills, the SEC and the FBI close in on his empire of excess.

title: Arlington Road
description: A U.S. history professor (Jeff Bridges), obsessed with radical groups, thinks his new neighbors (Tim Robbins, Joan Cusack) may be domestic terrorists.

title: The Beverly Hillbillies
description: Trying to cool a feud between Granny and Pearl, Jed takes his family on a sightseeing tour of Beverly Hills.

title: I Am Sartana, Trade Your Guns for a Coffin
description: After a bounty hunter watches an Old West gold heist, he follows the bandits in hope of making off with the loot.

title: A Mouse Tale
description: At the request of the king, Sebastian (Drake Bell) and Samantha (Miranda Cosgrove) must find a legendary crystal with the power to defeat an army of rats.

title: Du Barry Was a Lady
description: In this adaptation of a Cole Porter Broadway musical, star singer May wants to marry a rich man, but her heart belongs to a penniless dancer named Alec. Louis Blore, who has just won a fortune through the sweepstakes, promptly marries May. However, after Louis accidentally has a laced drink, he has a fantastic dream in which he, May and Alec are members of the royal French court. Once Louis awakens, he begins to reconsider his relationship with May.

However, his lack of ambition and her retreat into self-absorption cause potentially irreversible cracks in their marriage.

title: The Aging Brain
description: Learn what's behind mental decline with age, and how to improve memory, focus and concentration with NeuroQ's Darrin Peterson and Dale Bredesen MD.

title: The Lazarus Project
description: A death-row inmate (Paul Walker) searches for the truth after he mysteriously awakes in a psychiatric hospital.

title: Paid Programming
description: Paid programming.

title: Bridget Jones's Diary
description: At the start of the New Year, 32-year-old Bridget (Renée Zellweger) decides it's time to take control of her life -- and start keeping a diary. Now, the most provocative, erotic and hysterical book on her bedside table is the one she's writing. With a taste for adventure, and an opinion on every subject - from exercise to men to food to sex and everything in between - she's turning the page on a whole new life.

title: A Royal Recipe for Love
description: When Emma, a baker in NYC, is hired to bake for the king and queen of Sanovia's anniversary party, she is convinced a good job will lead to her landing a cookbook deal.

title: Great Photo, Lovely Life
description: Photojournalist Amanda Mustard turns her investigative lens on sexual abuse committed by her grandfather, beginning a personal journey in pursuit of the truth and reconciliation for her family.

title: Valley of the Sun
description: An Arizona frontiersman (James Craig) steals an Indian agent's girlfriend (Lucille Ball), followed by trouble.

title: Killer Adios
description: A young man goes back to his hometown ten years after killing the killer of his parents. Once there, he is asked to help the sheriff.

title: A Mermaid's Tale
description: Twelve-year-old Ryan is despondent about moving to a dying seacoast village until she forms an unlikely friendship with a quirky teenage mermaid.

title: Paid Programming

title: The Host
description: When an unseen enemy threatens mankind by taking over humans' bodies and erasing their minds, Melanie Stryder risks everything to protect the people she cares about most, proving that love can conquer all in a dangerous new world.

title: Maximum Overdrive
description: After a comet causes a radiation storm on Earth, machines come to life and turn against their makers. Holed up in a North Carolina truck stop, a group of survivors must fend for themselves against a mass of homicidal trucks. A diner cook, Bill Robinson (Emilio Estevez), emerges as the unlikely leader of the pack, attempting to find an escape plan for himself and the survivors, who include his boss, Bubba Hendershot (Pat Hingle), and a newlywed couple.

title: Planet Action
description: Special: Posthumanism; Trivia: Blade Runner 2049; Top 3: Posthumanism Movies; PBTS: Joe Letteri (VFX Supervisor 'Alita: Battle Angel'); MR: The Substance; AHOTW: Jude Law.

title: Titanic
description: Two young lovers from different backgrounds meet and fall in love on the ill-fated maiden voyage of the unsinkable R.M.S. Titanic.

title: Christmas Takes Flight
description: A number-crunching CEO buys a family-owned airline and cancels the airline's annual holiday charitable benefit. A pilot rallies the community to help save the event and unexpectedly finds herself falling for the magnate in the process.

title: It Could Happen to You
description: Charlie Lang (Nicolas Cage) is a simple, kindhearted New York City cop. When he realizes he has no money to tip waitress Yvonne Biasi (Bridget Fonda), Lang offers her half the winnings of his lottery ticket. Amazingly, the ticket happens to be a winner, in the sum of $4 million. True to his word, Lang proceeds to share the prize money with Biasi, which infuriates his greedy wife, Muriel (Rosie Perez). Not content with the arrangement, Muriel begins scheming to take all the money.

title: Project Baby
description: When a married couple must go out of town at the last minute, they ask their best friends to look after their son and plan his first birthday party.

title: Bewitched
description: Gladys comes dangerously close to learning the truth about Samantha.

title: When We Were Bullies
description: A coincidence leads filmmaker Jay Rosenblatt to track down his fifth-grade class and fifth-grade teacher to examine their memory of and complicity in a bullying incident 50 years ago.

title: Voyage to the Bottom of the Sea
description: Harriman Nelson (Walter Pidgeon) is the creator of a revolutionary nuclear submarine. After testing its capabilities in the Arctic Ocean, Nelson and the commanding officer (Robert Sterling) surface the vessel, only to discover the sky ablaze. Learning that the Van Allen radiation belt has caught fire, Nelson conceives a plan that could save the planet from destruction, but the U.N. shoots it down. Nelson is convinced it will work, but an onboard psychiatrist (Joan Fontaine) questions his sanity.

title: Moulin Rouge
description: A celebration of love and creative inspiration takes place in the infamous, gaudy and glamorous Parisian nightclub, at the cusp of the 20th century. A young poet (Ewan McGregor), who is plunged into the heady world of Moulin Rouge, begins a passionate affair with the club's most notorious and beautiful star (Nicole Kidman).

title: The Bravados
description: A Southwestern man (Gregory Peck) hunts to kill the four outlaws he blames for the rape/murder of his wife.

title: Wickensburg
description: When a mother and her young son move to a small town, they soon discover the town harbors a dark secret.

title: Paid Programming
description: Paid programming.

title: A Minute to Pray, a Second to Die
description: An outlaw (Alex Cord) hides out from good guys and bad guys, seeking amnesty, trying to go straight.

title: Diary of a Wimpy Kid: Dog Days
description: It's summer, and Greg Heffley (Zachary Gordon) is looking forward to playing video games and spending time with his friends. However, Greg's dad (Steve Zahn) has other plans: He's decided that some father-son bonding time is in order. Desperate to prevent his dad from ruining summer vacation, Greg pretends he has a job at a ritzy country club. But Greg's plan backfires, leaving him in the middle of embarrassing mishaps and a camping trip gone wrong.

title: Comet
description: A cynical lad (Justin Long) and a young woman (Emmy Rossum) begin a 6-year relationship after meeting by chance during a meteor shower.

title: Stir of Echoes
description: Blue-collar family man Tom Witzky (Kevin Bacon) scoffs at supernatural phenomena -- until he lets his wife's sister, Lisa (Illeana Douglas), put him into a hypnotic trance. Upon waking, Tom realizes he has a psychic connection with his son, Jake (Zachary David Cope). He also has alarming hallucinations of a missing teenage neighbor named Samantha (Jennifer Morrison). Tom, convinced his visions will lead him to the girl, begins a desperate search that puts him into a life-threatening situation.

title: 10 Steps to Love
description: Sophie, a successful marketing executive, has always used her 10-step plans to succeed in her goals. Naturally, she tries to use her plans to find love, but things take a turn when she meets Mason Wyatt, the grandson of orchard owners.

title: My Mom's New Boyfriend
description: After several years away, FBI agent Henry Durand (Colin Hanks) returns to find his mother, Marty (Meg Ryan), a much different person: Having long mourned for Henry's father, she is now embracing single life. One day, while Marty, Henry and his new fiancée, Emily (Selma Blair), are out for a walk, they meet Tommy (Antonio Banderas), a mysterious stranger, with whom Marty then becomes involved. However, through his FBI contacts, Henry learns that Tommy is suspected of being an art thief.

title: Return to Wickensburg
description: Mr. Hexenmeister has escaped from prison, and once again threatens Wickensburg. A race against time to find an ancient orb, capable of destroying the entire town, before it falls into the wrong hands.

title: The Neptune Factor
description: When an earthquake on the ocean floor causes an underwater laboratory to fall into a deep trench and places the scientists' lives in peril, Cmdr. Adrian Blake (Ben Gazzara) embarks on a rescue mission in his small experimental submarine. Along with a crew that includes Dr. Leah Jansen (Yvette Mimieux) and diver Don MacKay (Ernest Borgnine), Blake attempts to save the scientists from the unexplored depths, while encountering gigantic sea creatures that threaten their survival.

title: The Quick and the Dead
description: A mysterious stranger (Sam Elliott) befriends and protects a settler (Tom Conti) and his wife (Kate Capshaw) in 1876 Wyoming.

title: ParaNorman
description: Young Norman Babcock (Kodi Smit-McPhee) has the ability to speak with the dead -- and he often prefers their company to that of the living. Norman receives word from his strange Uncle Prenderghast (John Goodman) that a centuries-old witch's curse on their town is real and about to come true -- and that only Norman can stop it. When zombies rise from their graves, Norman must summon all his courage and compassion and push his paranormal abilities to the limit to save his fellow townspeople.

title: He's Just Not That Into You
description: Baltimore-based friends and lovers, all in their 20s and 30s, try to navigate their way through the complexities of modern relationships. Beth (Jennifer Aniston) wants commitment from Neil (Ben Affleck), who sees nothing wrong with the status quo. Gigi (Ginnifer Goodwin) is tired of waiting by the phone, while Mary (Drew Barrymore) has a slew of supportive male friends, none of whom are straight. Meanwhile, Janine has trust issues with her husband, who can't trust himself around Anna.

title: Shane
description: An ex-gunfighter (Alan Ladd) sides with Wyoming homesteaders (Jean Arthur, Van Heflin) against a ruthless cattle baron.

title: Malaya
description: Soon after the Japanese attack on Pearl Harbor, cynical former newspaper correspondent John Royer (James Stewart) devises a scheme with his old editor and government agents to return to the Far East and smuggle out a vast amount of rubber for the war effort. Demanding the freedom and company of his ex-friend, Carnahan (Spencer Tracy), whom he betrayed in an exposé years earlier, Royer sails off into the hands of the Japanese with a motley crew, gold and the promise of covert government aid.

title: Sister Act
description: When lively lounge singer Deloris Van Cartier (Whoopi Goldberg) sees her mobster beau, Vince LaRocca (Harvey Keitel), commit murder, she is relocated for her protection. Set up in the guise of a nun in a California convent, Deloris proceeds to upend the quiet lives of the resident sisters. In an effort to keep her out of trouble, they assign Deloris to the convent's choir, an ensemble that she soon turns into a vibrant and soulful act that gains widespread attention.

title: I Want Him Dead
description: After his sister is kidnapped and murdered, a gunslinger's plans for vengeance involve assassinating two generals to prolong the Civil War.

title: Christmas Takes Flight
description: A number-crunching CEO buys a family-owned airline and cancels the airline's annual holiday charitable benefit. A pilot rallies the community to help save the event and unexpectedly finds herself falling for the magnate in the process.

title: Tom Clancy's Without Remorse
description: Seeking justice for the murder of his pregnant wife, an elite Navy SEAL uncovers a covert plot that threatens to engulf the United States and Russia in an all-out war.

title: Shakespeare in Love
description: "Shakespeare in Love" is a romantic comedy for the 1990s set in the 1590s. It imaginatively unfolds the witty, sexy and timeless tale behind the creation of the greatest love story ever told. A young Shakespeare is out of cash and ideas; he meets his ideal woman and she inspires him to write one of his most famous plays.

title: Santa Stole Our Dog!
description: Members of the Whitehaven family travel to the magical North Pole when their beloved dog Rusty goes missing on Christmas Eve.

title: Moulin Rouge
description: A celebration of love and creative inspiration takes place in the infamous, gaudy and glamorous Parisian nightclub, at the cusp of the 20th century. A young poet (Ewan McGregor), who is plunged into the heady world of Moulin Rouge, begins a passionate affair with the club's most notorious and beautiful star (Nicole Kidman).

title: A Dog and Pony Show
description: Dede, a famous performing circus dog, gets left behind when her show leaves town. When she is adopted by a lonely boy on a farm, the vain dog has to learn to get along with the other animals.

title: Love By Design
description: Broken-hearted Brooke Yeardley makes her 30th birthday wish on the vision board she made as a teen. As her wishes start coming true, she finds out that life doesn't always follow a plan.

title: Defendor
description: An everyday guy (Woody Harrelson) believes he is a superhero and befriends a teenager while seeing a psychiatrist.

title: The Frozen Ground
description: A teenage escapee provides a critical break in the case, as an Alaskan detective hunts a serial killer who has been preying on women for 13 years.

title: Cocoon
description: Oscar-winning fantasy in which the residents of a Florida rest home get a new lease of life when they stumble across an alien "fountain of youth" in a disused holiday home. Unbeknown to them, aliens have been using the swimming pool in the house to store their cocooned brethren, giving the waters a powerful, rejuvenating quality.

title: Desk Set
description: Bunny Watson (Katharine Hepburn) is a library reference clerk stuck in a dead-end relationship with a boring television executive (Gig Young). Her life is thrown into turmoil when computer expert Richard Sumner (Spencer Tracy) enters it. He has been assigned with automating her department, and she is fearful that Summers' new computers will automate her out of a job. She despises him at first, but eventually each of the two start to fall for the other's charms and strong personalities.

title: Dr. Seuss' Horton Hears a Who!
description: Animated elephant Horton finds a speck of dust floating in the Jungle of Nool. Upon investigation of the speck, Horton discovers the tiny city of Whoville and its residents, the Whos, which he can hear but cannot see. Horton forms a friendship with the mayor of Whoville, Ned McDodd, and promises to transport Whoville to safety. However, Horton encounters opposition from his jungle neighbors, who don't want to believe in the existence of Whoville.

title: Marlowe
description: Detective Philip Marlowe becomes embroiled in an investigation with a wealthy family in Bay City, Calif., after a beautiful blonde hires him to find her former lover.

title: Comet
description: A cynical lad (Justin Long) and a young woman (Emmy Rossum) begin a 6-year relationship after meeting by chance during a meteor shower.

title: The Legend of the Lone Ranger
description: Bad guy Butch Cavendish (Christopher Lloyd) leads an ambush on the Texas Rangers, gunning down all but the young John Reid (Klinton Spilsbury), a lawyer who had joined his Ranger brother, Dan (John Bennett Perry), in the pursuit of Cavendish. Reid, who was injured in the attack, slowly recovers with the help of his childhood friend, the Native American Tonto (Michael Horse). Afterward, Reid dons a mask, calls himself the Lone Ranger and begins fighting evil with Tonto.

title: Hugo
description: Orphaned and alone except for an uncle, Hugo Cabret lives in the walls of a train station in the 1930s Paris. Hugo's job is to oil and maintain the station's clocks, but to him, his more important task is to protect a broken automaton and notebook left to him by his late father. Accompanied by the goddaughter of an embittered toy merchant, Hugo embarks on a quest to solve the mystery of the automaton and find a place he can call home.

title: Cheaper by the Dozen
description: Tom and Kate Baker compromise their careers to raise 12 children. Tom coaches a high-school football team, while Kate has retired from journalism to raise the family. Things change when Tom is offered a college coaching job in a new city at the same time a publisher buys Kate's parenting memoir. After moving, Kate goes on a book tour, leaving Tom in charge of the children. The children, already unhappy about relocating, plunge the household into chaos.

title: The Tomorrow War
description: Soldiers and civilians travel to the year 2051 to join a global war against a deadly alien species.

title: Beautiful Wave
description: A New York teen (Aimee Teegarden) discovers a family secret while spending the summer in California with her estranged grandmother (Patricia Richardson).

title: Chocolat
description: When mysterious Vianne and her child arrive in a tranquil French town in the winter of 1959, no one could have imagined the impact that she and her spirited daughter would have on the community stubbornly rooted in tradition. Within days, she opens an unusual chocolate shop, across the square from the church. Her ability to perceive her customers' desires and satisfy them with just the right confection, coaxes the villagers to abandon themselves to temptation -- just as Lent begins.

title: A Guy Named Joe
description: A bomber pilot (Spencer Tracy) goes to heaven and becomes guardian angel to another pilot (Van Johnson) courting his old girlfriend (Irene Dunne).

title: Modeled With Love
description: Olivia believes that she's the obvious pick to take over when her father retires from their modeling company. Newcomer Simon threatens to upend Olivia's comfortable bubble along with her role as successor.

title: Boys Go to Jupiter
description: Billy 5000, a teenage gig worker with a rise-and-grind mindset, aims to make $5,000. His quest is derailed by a gelatinous alien's appearance.

title: The Medallion
description: Eddie (Jackie Chan) is an indomitable Hong Kong cop who, after a near fatal accident involving a mysterious medallion, is suddenly transformed into a Highbinder -- an immortal warrior with inhuman powers. Eddie enlists the help of fellow agent Nicole (Claire Forlani) to determine the secret of the medallion and face down the evil Highbinders who so desperately want it back.

title: Killshot
description: A veteran assassin (Mickey Rourke) and his dangerous young partner (Joseph Gordon-Levitt) pursue a woman (Diane Lane) and her husband (Thomas Jane) who stumbled upon an extortion scheme. Though the frightened couple enter the Witness Protection Program, they fear that the government is no match for two relentless killers.

title: Sister Act
description: When lively lounge singer Deloris Van Cartier (Whoopi Goldberg) sees her mobster beau, Vince LaRocca (Harvey Keitel), commit murder, she is relocated for her protection. Set up in the guise of a nun in a California convent, Deloris proceeds to upend the quiet lives of the resident sisters. In an effort to keep her out of trouble, they assign Deloris to the convent's choir, an ensemble that she soon turns into a vibrant and soulful act that gains widespread attention.

title: The Inglorious Bastards
description: Two officers (Bo Svenson, Ian Bannen) lead military misfits on a mission to steal a Nazi V-2 rocket gyroscope.

title: Santa Stole Our Dog!
description: Members of the Whitehaven family travel to the magical North Pole when their beloved dog Rusty goes missing on Christmas Eve.

title: Thirty Seconds Over Tokyo
description: During World War II, Lt. Col. James H. Doolittle (Spencer Tracy) leads the U.S. Air Force in a bombing mission over Japan. Doolittle and his men stage a successful attack on Tokyo, but most pilots run out of fuel while returning from the raid. Many are forced to land on Japanese soil, but Capt. Ted Lawson (Van Johnson), who has a pregnant wife at home, crash-lands in the sea off the coast of China. Stranded, Lawson must heroically endure a series of harrowing challenges to make it back home.

title: The Butcher's Wife
description: Clairvoyant Marina (Demi Moore) meets New York City butcher Leo Lemke (George Dzundza) while he is visiting her small town in North Carolina. When she then dreams about him, she believes it is a sign that he is her true love. She marries Leo and moves to his working-class neighborhood in New York City. There she meets his neighbors, including shy singer Stella (Mary Steenburgen) and psychiatrist Alex Tremor (Jeff Daniels). Soon Marina begins to wonder if she was wrong about her soul mate.

title: Crazy Westerners
description: Hoping to rid the world of evil, a female gunslinger (Rita Pavone) steals gold and plans to destroy it.

title: The Peanuts Movie
description: Life always seems complicated for good ol' Charlie Brown (Noah Schnapp), the boy who always tries his best against seemingly impossible odds. When the Little Red-Haired Girl moves into his neighborhood, Charlie Brown develops a crush on her. Meanwhile, his best friend Snoopy embarks on an epic adventure in a fantasy world. As a World War I flying ace, the lovable beagle pursues his nemesis, the Red Baron, while also trying to win the heart of a beautiful poodle named Fifi (Kristin Chenoweth).

title: Plymouth Adventure
description: Stubborn Capt. Christopher Jones (Spencer Tracy) pilots the historically famous Mayflower on its maiden voyage across the storm-swept Atlantic. Thankfully, a resourceful carpenter (Van Johnson) keeps the weather damage in check. Also among the passengers is Dorothy (Gene Tierney), the wife of the religiously zealous leader of the pilgrims. Jones finds himself drawn to Dorothy, despite her unattainable status. Soon a rivalry between his unsavory crew and the prim and proper pilgrims emerges.

title: Bernie the Dolphin
description: A brother and sister befriend a badly sunburned dolphin that has been separated from its family, uncovering a secret plan that could destroy the beach and their new friend's home.

title: The Outlaws
description: A group of outlaws awaken to their empty train heist bag. Interrogations begin as each cowboy becomes the focus in an attempt to unmask the thief among them. Tensions mount as each bandit struggles to clear their name before bullets fly.

title: Two for the Money
description: A former college athlete (Matthew McConaughey) joins forces with a sports consultant (Al Pacino) to handicap football games for high-rolling gamblers.

title: Supergirl
description: Kara (Helen Slater) of Argo City poses as Clark Kent's cousin, Linda Lee, to recover the Omegahedron from a witch (Faye Dunaway).

title: Labor Pains
description: Desperate to keep her job, an employee (Lindsay Lohan) at a publishing company pretends to be pregnant.

title: Ghost
description: Sam Wheat (Patrick Swayze) is a banker, Molly Jensen (Demi Moore) is an artist, and the two are madly in love. However, when Sam is murdered by friend and corrupt business partner Carl Bruner (Tony Goldwyn) over a shady business deal, he is left to roam the earth as a powerless spirit. When he learns of Carl's betrayal, Sam must seek the help of psychic Oda Mae Brown (Whoopi Goldberg) to set things right and protect Molly from Carl and his goons.

title: Black Hawk Down
description: In 1993, the U.S. sends special forces into Somalia to destabilize the government and bring food and humanitarian aid to the starving population. Using Black Hawk helicopters to lower the soldiers onto the ground, an unexpected attack by Somalian forces brings two of the helicopters down immediately. From there, the U.S. soldiers must struggle to regain their balance while enduring heavy gunfire.

title: Samaritan
description: Thirteen-year-old Sam Cleary suspects that his mysterious and reclusive neighbor, Mr. Smith, is actually a legend hiding in plain sight. Twenty-five years ago, Granite City's superpowered vigilante, Samaritan, was reported dead after a fiery warehouse battle with his rival, Nemesis. Most believe he perished in the fire, but some, like Sam, have hope that he's still alive. With crime now on the rise, Sam makes it his mission to coax Samaritan out of hiding to save the city from ruin.

title: Cold Pursuit
description: Nels Coxman's quiet life as a snowplow driver comes crashing down when his beloved son dies under mysterious circumstances. His search for the truth soon becomes a quest for revenge against a psychotic drug lord named Viking and his sleazy henchmen. Transformed from upstanding citizen to coldblooded vigilante, Coxman unwittingly sets off a chain of events that includes a kidnapping, a series of deadly misunderstandings and a turf war between Viking and a rival boss.

title: Hugo
description: Orphaned and alone except for an uncle, Hugo Cabret lives in the walls of a train station in the 1930s Paris. Hugo's job is to oil and maintain the station's clocks, but to him, his more important task is to protect a broken automaton and notebook left to him by his late father. Accompanied by the goddaughter of an embittered toy merchant, Hugo embarks on a quest to solve the mystery of the automaton and find a place he can call home.

title: Cheaper by the Dozen
description: Tom and Kate Baker compromise their careers to raise 12 children. Tom coaches a high-school football team, while Kate has retired from journalism to raise the family. Things change when Tom is offered a college coaching job in a new city at the same time a publisher buys Kate's parenting memoir. After moving, Kate goes on a book tour, leaving Tom in charge of the children. The children, already unhappy about relocating, plunge the household into chaos.

title: An Affair to Remember
description: Engaged to others, two cruise-ship passengers (Cary Grant, Deborah Kerr) plan to reunite six months later atop the Empire State Building.

title: Rules of Engagement
description: Col. Terry Childers (Samuel L. Jackson) is a 30-year Marine veteran: a decorated officer with combat experience in Vietnam, Beirut and Desert Storm -- a patriot, a hero. But now, the country he served so well has put him on trial for a rescue mission that went terribly wrong. For his attorney, he has chosen Marine Col. Hays Hodges (Tommy Lee Jones), a comrade-in-arms who owes his life to Childers.

title: Gangs of New York
description: Amsterdam Vallon (Leonardo DiCaprio) is a young Irish immigrant released from prison.
